test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

I shall be cook my favourite dish tonight for the party.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb "**cook**" after "**I shall be**."
 
• The correct form should be "**cooking**" to match the future continuous tense.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**I shall be cooking**" ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I shall be cooking my favourite dish tonight for the party."*
